basic_info.description: Luxurious 1 bed, 1 bath + a DEN with a custom Murphy Bed at 1 of South Beach's premier boutique buildings with a historic facade! Rare floorplan when you need more space, and a traditional 1 bedroom just won't cut it!  Cleverly designed to access the bathroom from the living room as well as the bedroom.  Significantly upgraded with Viking gas range, stainless steel appliances, bamboo flooring, custom closet organizers, customizable lighting & custom window treatments. Also comes with in-unit washer/dryer, parking and storage. INCREDIBLE common sky lounge equipped with a gas BBQ and a sink and stunning views of the Ballpark and the Bay!  A+ LOCATION!  1 block to Oracle Park - home of THE GIANTS, and conveniently located near The Chase Center, The Embarcadero, South Park, Blue Bottle, restaurants, bars, movie theaters, a bowling alley and public transportation including Caltrain and MUNI. Easy access to highways 101 & 280 and a quick commute to SFO. An ideal starter home or pied a terre that is not to be missed!
